title: The push-main ask judges the target remote, and stays silent for a repo with no such remote or a local-path remote
why: A false alarm reached the owner as a prompt at 10:02 CST Nov 8: an agent of lane review-record-provenance ran `git -C <scratchpad>/pr/src push origin main` in a test fixture repo with no origin remote, and the guard asked.
note: Filed 10:05 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 10:03 CST, item 410 a). Decision plain-push-asks. Keep the ask for the real GitHub repo. Red case: that command in a fixture repo with no origin.
